Foreign universities to offer degrees in India at reduced cost

Several foreign universities are planning to open campuses in India, potentially making foreign degrees more accessible. One report estimates that over 5 lakh students could study at these campuses by 2040. This development could significantly reduce the cost of obtaining a foreign degree within India.
